title: Reply request
description: Body of POST /v1/events/{event_id}/reply: the text the user entered on the watch for a replyable Notification event (docs/TZ.md F3, §5.6). The watch sends it once with its device token; the relay answers 202 once FCM took reply.execute for the Companion.

reply_id.description: New for every reply, so the relay can tell a resend apart.

text.description: At most 800 characters, so the reply.execute envelope fits the 4096 bytes FCM allows for data even in four-byte characters. The relay also refuses, with 400 invalid_request, a reply whose envelope would still outgrow them, such as one of control characters that JSON escapes to six bytes each.

sent_at.description: When the user sent the reply on the watch; RFC3339 UTC.
